title: The Entire History of the Ottoman Empire

lines: Around 1300, a small band of Turkish horsemen held a few villages in northwestern Anatolia.
Within two centuries, their descendants ruled Constantinople, Cairo and the holy cities of Arabia, and stood at the gates of Vienna.
Then, slowly, the empire changed, shrank, and in 1922, it was gone.
This is the story of the Ottoman Empire, in sixteen chapters.
From Osman's frontier to a new republic in Ankara: six hundred and twenty-three years.
Which empire should we sketch next? Let us know in the comments.
